India to End Boarding Pass Stamping for International Travelers

India will discontinue the practice of stamping boarding passes for international travelers at airports starting September 1. This decision aims to streamline the immigration process. The change applies to all international flights departing from Indian airports. Previously, passengers were required to have their boarding passes stamped as part of the security and immigration procedures.
